title: The First Vision
description: Sit an hour at the old shrine near Crossroads and bring me back the token. An hour of doing nothing tells me more about you than a week of talking would. Acolytes who cannot sit still do not last.

objectives.description: Sit at the shrine near Crossroads
Bring the token back to the Priest

notes: Giver motive: the priest tests with stillness before he spends real teaching on a stranger - a wasted hour costs him nothing, a wasted year costs the temple an acolyte who quits partway. Consequence: this is the filter the rest of the questline sits behind; nobody who cannot sit through one quiet hour is offered the next one. Not wired mechanically - the filtering is the priest's private judgment, not a gate in data.
